Jack and Lily are preparing a report about the science lab. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Best of all, my brother goes to university in Beijing.

Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Sydney. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. For example, I ordered a cheese enchilada with red chilli sauce.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. On Saturday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. Lily prefers cloudy weather when running in the bookstore. He studies Spanish in an evening class.

At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. The experience taught Lily more than any book could. The classroom has become an important part of daily life. What's more, the provost revised the exam rules.
The science lab looked quieter than usual that evening. Lily thanked Jack for the honest advice. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
